mapper.select: select user_id as userId, pw, name, phone, birth, att_id as attId, ticket from account;
mapper.insert: insert into account (user_id, pw, name, phone, birth) values (#{userId}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{birth});
mapper.update: update account set pw = #{pw}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, birth = #{birth}, att_id = #{attId}, ticket = #{ticket} where user_id = #{userId};
